tagline.zh: 一个字体文件携带连续轴:font-variation-settings 拨动 wght/opsz,字重与光学字号从离散档位变成连续滑杆。
tagline.en: One font file carrying continuous axes: font-variation-settings turns wght/opsz dials — weight and optical size become continuous sliders instead of discrete cuts.

origin.zh: 机制 = OpenType 字体变体(fvar 表):五个注册轴 wght/wdth/slnt/ital/opsz,取值标尺在轴注册时定义、各字体可支持子区间;高级语法 font-variation-settings 轴名大小写敏感且须整体重申所有轴值(MDN 可变字体指南 + Microsoft OpenType 规范,调研 05§20)。demo 字体 Inter 的轴标尺 opsz 14–32、wght 100–900 出自 rsms/inter 官方技术规格(调研 05§24)。
origin.en: Mechanism = OpenType font variations (the fvar table): five registered axes wght/wdth/slnt/ital/opsz, each with a registry-defined scale that fonts may support in subranges; the low-level font-variation-settings syntax is case-sensitive and must restate all axis values (MDN variable fonts guide + Microsoft OpenType spec, research 05 §20). The demo font Inter publishes opsz 14–32 and wght 100–900 per rsms/inter's official spec (research 05 §24).

effect.zh: 字重轴(CSS 型,注入 --vf-wght,demo 经 font-variation-settings 消费)。Inter 标尺 100–900:Thin 100 到 Black 900 共 9 个静态档(调研 05§24),可变格式下为连续取值;默认 400(Regular)是注册轴默认,与本仓 @fontsource-variable/inter 的 metadata.json 一致。写入方式建议优先用高层属性 font-weight,需要非整数或与其它轴联控时才用 font-variation-settings。
effect.en: The weight axis (CSS-type, injected as --vf-wght and consumed via font-variation-settings). Inter's scale 100–900 spans nine static cuts from Thin 100 to Black 900 (research 05 §24) — continuous on the variable format; default 400 (Regular) is the registered-axis default and matches @fontsource-variable/inter's metadata.json in this repo. Prefer the high-level font-weight property; drop to font-variation-settings for fractional values or multi-axis control.

effect.zh: 光学字号轴(CSS 型,注入 --vf-opsz)。Inter 标尺 14–32(rsms/inter 官方规格,调研 05§24):14 是 text 档,配高 x-height(1118/2048 UPM)提升小字号可读性;32 是 display 档(x-height 1056/2048),对比更强、更紧凑。默认 14 = 轴最小值(本仓 @fontsource-variable/inter metadata.json 同值);设 font-optical-sizing: none 才能手动控轴,auto 时浏览器按 font-size 自动选档。
effect.en: The optical size axis (CSS-type, injected as --vf-opsz). Inter's scale 14–32 (rsms/inter official spec, research 05 §24): 14 is the text optical size with a tall x-height (1118/2048 UPM) for small sizes; 32 is the display optical size (x-height 1056/2048) with tighter, higher-contrast forms. Default 14 = the axis minimum (same value in this repo's @fontsource-variable/inter metadata.json); set font-optical-sizing: none to drive the axis manually — auto lets the browser pick per font-size.

note.zh: 可变字体(fvar)与 font-variation-settings 在三大引擎的现代版本均可用;调研 05 未记录分浏览器首发版本号(未证实),此处不作逐版本断言。写法上先给 font-weight 兜底,再用 font-variation-settings 叠加轴控制。
note.en: Variable fonts (fvar) and font-variation-settings work in current versions of all three engines; research 05 did not record per-browser release numbers (unverified), so none are claimed. Write a font-weight fallback first, then layer axis control with font-variation-settings.

fallback.zh: 不支持 font-variation-settings 的浏览器把整条声明当作无效丢弃:先写 font-weight(高层属性映射 wght 轴)保住字重,再写 font-variation-settings 叠加精细控制;opsz 无高层等价物,可依赖 font-optical-sizing 的默认 auto 让支持的环境自动选档。字体文件层面,@font-face 未加载成功时按 font-family 栈回退到系统字体。
fallback.en: Browsers without font-variation-settings drop the whole declaration: keep weight via font-weight first (the high-level property maps to the wght axis), then layer font-variation-settings for fine control; opsz has no high-level equivalent, so rely on font-optical-sizing: auto (the default) where supported. At the file level, a failed @font-face falls back down the font-family stack to system fonts.

use.zh: 设计系统的字重细谱:350/450/650 这类非静态档位,一行 CSS 完成
use.en: Fine weight spectra in design systems — 350/450/650 cuts in one CSS line

use.zh: 标题排版用 display 光学档(opsz 调高)、小字 UI 用 text 档(opsz 调低)
use.en: Display optical sizes for headlines (opsz up) and text optical sizes for small UI (opsz down)

use.zh: 单一字体文件替代 9 个静态字重回退,减少请求数与 FOUT 概率
use.en: One variable file replacing nine static weight files — fewer requests, less FOUT

use.zh: hover/交互态在字重轴上做 ±50 微移(克制使用,避免布局抖动)
use.en: Hover states nudging wght by ±50 (used sparingly to avoid layout jitter)

avoid.zh: 正文用极细字重(接近 100)——细字重在低分辨率与低对比环境下可读性差
avoid.en: Body text near wght 100 — hairline weights read poorly at low resolution and low contrast

avoid.zh: 把 font-variation-settings 当唯一字重来源却不写 font-weight 兜底——旧浏览器整条丢失
avoid.en: Relying on font-variation-settings alone with no font-weight fallback — old browsers lose the declaration entirely

avoid.zh: 字重动画铺开到整段正文——每帧重排字形,性能与可读性双输
avoid.en: Animating weight across body text — glyphs re-rasterize every frame, costing both performance and readability

avoid.zh: 手写轴名拼错大小写(如 Wght)——轴名大小写敏感,静默失效
avoid.en: Mis-casing axis names (e.g. Wght) — names are case-sensitive and fail silently

a11y.zh: 字重直接影响可读性:正文建议 ≥400,标题可用更重档位;极细字重在小字号与低对比度下难以辨认,应避免(WCAG 1.4.3 对比度之外的字形可读性考量)。opsz 的 text 档(Inter 14,高 x-height)专为小字号设计——小字 UI 显式选低 opsz,大标题选高 opsz。字重变化会改变字形宽度,注意不要引起文本换行点漂移导致内容跳动。
a11y.en: Weight directly affects legibility: keep body at 400 or above and reserve heavier cuts for display; hairline weights are hard to read at small sizes and low contrast (beyond WCAG 1.4.3 contrast). Inter's text optical size (opsz 14, tall x-height) is designed for small sizes — pick low opsz for small UI and high for display. Weight changes glyph widths, so avoid shifts that move line breaks and make content jump.

goal.zh: 用 Inter Variable 复刻一组字重/光学字号联动排版:标题与正文共享同一可变字体文件,通过 font-variation-settings 精确指定 wght 与 opsz 轴值。
goal.en: Replicate a weight/optical-size typography set with Inter Variable: one variable file shared by headings and body, with exact wght and opsz axis values via font-variation-settings.

acceptance.zh: font-family 使用本仓已装的 Inter Variable(@fontsource-variable/inter,standard 全轴文件)
acceptance.en: font-family uses Inter Variable from the installed @fontsource-variable/inter (standard full-axis files)

acceptance.zh: wght/opsz 严格使用参数快照值,轴名小写加引号,大小写敏感
acceptance.en: wght/opsz use the exact parameter snapshot values; axis names are quoted and lowercase — case-sensitive

acceptance.zh: 声明 font-variation-settings 时整体重申全部轴值(低层属性会覆盖高层 font-weight)
acceptance.en: Restate every axis value together when declaring font-variation-settings (the low-level property overrides high-level font-weight)

acceptance.zh: 先写 font-weight 数值兜底,再写 font-variation-settings 叠加
acceptance.en: Write a numeric font-weight fallback first, then layer font-variation-settings

acceptance.zh: 手动控 opsz 时同时声明 font-optical-sizing: none,避免 auto 覆盖手动轴值
acceptance.en: When driving opsz manually, also declare font-optical-sizing: none so auto does not override the axis value
